title: Under new licensing requirements, the US Commerce Department says exports of Nvidia's H200 chips and AMD's MI325X chips will be reviewed on a case-by-case basis (Bloomberg)
summary: Bloomberg: Under new licensing requirements, the US Commerce Department says exports of Nvidia's H200 chips and AMD's MI325X chips will be reviewed on a case-by-case basis — The Trump administration moved closer to allowing Nvidia Corp. to sell its H200 artificial intelligence chips to China …
